Body.Content:
Information workers can now use model-app-builder skill in Copilot Cowork to create and refine model-driven apps from natural-language requirements. Cowork turns a business scenario into an app specification and build plan for review before creating the model-driven app and its supporting Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse artifacts. By handling repetitive artifact creation, makers can move from an idea to a working app fast and spend more time refining the app's design and business experience. Makers can continue iterating through conversation in Cowork or open the generated artifacts in Power Apps for direct customization.
